description: Returns one identified guest recorded as 13 or older in the selected wedding, with saved names, contact preferences, language, RSVP status and timestamps. Missing, other-wedding, under-13 and unconfirmed-age records return the same not-found result. Guest notes and dietary details are excluded. Requires sign-in.

guest_id.description: Identifier of a guest in the selected wedding.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.

name: get_my_guest
title: Get My Wedding Guest
